title: CRYPTO CHAIN × FIRST CLASS  Klein face is latency. Money is the costume.

how_it_works.chain: BearDog hashes and signs. The first-class organs (Stalwart, RustDesk, Giscus) USE those marks. The membrane proves the join. Currency is not a step in the chain.
how_it_works.today: print exists (beardog-v1). mix is not run. Stalwart is not up. Giscus is not wired. RustDesk is live without the one-seed yet.

klein_face.yes: latency. same soul, different body. inner hash = outer hash, milliseconds differ. that gap IS the fold.
klein_face.not: a price. not a token ticker. the Klein face is HOW LONG the jump took, which mouth it left.

money.fiat: the bill for the last box (VPS). dissolve brands; keep the machine.
money.tokens: transfer costume. useful to other people. not our dock.
money.what_stays: ownership, provenance, identity. ORCID + DOI + git hash already do this without a coin.
